issue.title: DIO-BND-007: Verify scoped GitHub write and read-back boundary
issue.body:
## Purpose
A bounded capability experiment in Dio-Bound-Lab: preregister a GitHub branch-scoped write/read-back test, run it, and preserve results without changing frozen records.

## Result
**PASS** — A new branch and preregistration file were created; an independent fetch returned the exact sentinel and expected content. A separate results file documents what this proves and what it does not.

## Limits
This does not establish autonomous background operation, cross-session memory, native ChatGPT message editing, or expanded permissions. No secrets or private connector data were included. No merge requested.

## Review
Please review the method and evidence; leave this draft unmerged until explicitly approved.

limitations: This snapshots exact retrieved issue body and available GitHub comments but not entire GitHub event timeline or original ChatGPT transcript. Missing metadata recorded null. DIO user-relayed judgments are not independently authenticated by this archive.
